title: Getting Dressed Steps
hook: Wear what fits the day and the body.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: colorful 3D clothing storybook, child-friendly garments and accessories, clean single-item presentation; visual identity: Getting Dressed Steps

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child getting dressed with choices
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Getting Dressed Steps a flexible dressing sequence: underwear/base not in mapping is acknowledged implicitly; choose weather/activity, then shirt/layers, bottoms, socks, shoes, outer accessories—without enforcing one universal order.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child uses a decision tree rather than rigid chant: some items are optional, some belong to work/sleep, and scarf/necktie need snag awareness.
